summary:
Walmart’s spark is the tab icon on walmart.com. Grocery and store-pickup bookmarks use that same host, so this page records the icon files walmart.com returned.

Checked 12 November 2026 against walmart.com. HTML came from https://www.walmart.com/ (HTTP 200). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.walmart.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 15086 bytes. Directory sizes: 48×48, 32×32, 16×16.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.walmart.com/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 180×180 png.

Brand colour #ffcc22 comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-180x180-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-180x180-01.png at 180×180 (png, 7882 bytes) from https://www.walmart.com/apple-touch-icon.png.
